ShaderNodeType:NODE_ATTR.notes: Static-triangle object/mesh/face/vertex/corner attributes: 48 compiled graphs plus 328 typed programs; 5,088 Linux evaluations, seven rejected inputs. Derivative/bump variants, non-Rec709 color conversion, negative offsets and 64-bit identities are CPU-compared on Linux. Plain native graphs replay on four GPUs; UV-driven complete render also passes. Other domains, general bump state, production image coverage and all native RIDs remain open; strict differences persist.

ShaderNodeType:NODE_TEX_IMAGE.notes: Resident ImageManager transport: eight formats, four filters and four extension modes; 115,650 original-CPU sampling cases. 128 native graphs plus 176 typed projection/derivative programs total 1,824 evaluations; 14 invalid inputs reject. Sampling and 768 native graph evaluations replay on four GPUs. Typed image/box/environment projections and derivative variants currently execute on Linux only. The complete generated-image textured native render has independent CPU-film and repeated-GPU gates. Strict differences, tiled/mipmap cache/retry, sparse 3D, production decoder/color/UDIM/animation/edit coverage, original asset materials and all native RIDs remain open.

ImageDataType:IMAGE_DATA_TYPE_FLOAT4.notes: Eight resident storage formats and five native alpha modes are exercised through PNG/JPEG/OpenEXR ImageManager file loading with five color selections. Linux runs 450 parameter variants, independent known lossless texels and queued replacement/lifetime checks. A final 116352-sample corpus passes four-GPU replay; Android file decoding and lifecycle are not proven. Earlier resident synthetic sampling includes four filters/extensions. TIFF/LZW and other format paths, production OCIO/cache/animation stress and all native platform hosts remain required.

Full bump state, motion/other geometry, degenerate plain-tangent nonfinite behavior, original asset materials and all native hosts remain open; strict differences persist.
